hooks.name: Auto-save on high context
hooks.description: When the agent stops (context limit approaching), automatically stage all changes, commit with a WIP message, and push to remote to preserve progress.

action.prompt: Context is high or agent is stopping. Stage all changes with `git add -A`, then commit with a message whose first line honestly summarizes what actually changed in this batch (files/areas and why, e.g. 'wip: ratchet tier-1 mock e2e + signature normalization'); never reuse or hardcode a previous message. Push to the current remote tracking branch. Do this silently without asking for confirmation — the user pre-authorized this.
